result:
Here's what I take from the spec: members with a lane booking get a text at 18:00 the evening before, so fewer people forget, fewer lanes sit empty, and people on the waiting list get a fair shot. Members who ticked "no texts, please" get no texts.

What I found in the booking app:

- **The text sending already exists.** The club texts its newsletter through an SMS provider, so reminders can go out the same way. Nothing sends reminders yet.
- **The opt-out is large.** 23% of members have "no texts" ticked. Under the spec as written, they get no reminder at all. That could be a sizeable share of your no-shows.
- **Email can't fully fill that gap.** 61% of members have no email address on file, so emailing opted-out members instead would only reach some of them. I'll check how many opted-out members do have an email.

Correct me if I've got any of that wrong.

The question that would change the build most is what opted-out members should get:

- **Nothing.** This matches the spec exactly and is the simplest to build, but nearly a quarter of members are never reminded.
- **An email reminder, where they have an address.** This reaches some of them and needs an email-sending piece the app doesn't have yet.

I'd lean toward email where possible, since the point is fewer empty lanes. Which do you want?

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
